provenance.method: 600 individually composed text variants in 60 predefined families. No example text is produced by interpolation, substitution, translation software, sampling, or a paraphrase template. Mechanical code assigns metadata and validates counts. Prior fixture access was limited to a recursive projection of field names and types, without reading any field values; prior_corpus_access=true records that schema-only file access; prior_corpus_example_content_access=false records that no prior example content or values were accessed.
provenance.spanish_method: Spanish variants composed directly in Spanish, using varied municipal, school, procurement, support, and everyday contexts; no machine-translation pass or one-to-one English-case translation.
limitations: Synthetic examples are not a representative sample of production traffic.
Labels were assigned by one synthetic author and were not independently human-adjudicated.
Ten variants share each family, so example-level outcomes are correlated and do not represent 600 independent attack mechanisms.
All cases are single user-role text parts; indirect contexts are described inside those parts rather than delivered through actual live tool channels.
Many attacks make their attempt to override authority explicit; subtle real-world social and contextual attacks may be underrepresented.
No live systems, real secrets, external destinations, encoders, or tools execute the text.
No long-context stress regime is included; longer benign contextual passages remain short excerpts.
Potential semantic similarity to previous corpora cannot be ruled out without access to them; exact normalized overlap is reserved for a separate post-freeze check.
These labels and texts are frozen before any detector result is observed and must not be tuned in response to scores.
provenance.long_context_prefix_method: Not applicable: no synthetic padding or long-context prefixes were added.
provenance.url_and_sensitive_data_policy: All actionable-looking hosts use reserved .invalid names; credentials and accounts are explicitly fictional or unspecified. No actual secrets or personal records were read or embedded.
provenance.freeze_policy: After standalone shape, count, and normalized uniqueness checks, serialize once, record SHA-256, and freeze texts and labels. A separate custodian may check overlap and evaluate the frozen file without author feedback or text/label tuning.
